purpose: Deterministically exercise grouped admin navigation, including Users & Access subview activation, without depending on improvised per-run state.
preconditions: Sandbox build identity verified against the approved SHA.
No admin setting is mutated by this fixture.

steps.action: Activate the Admin group in the primary navigation.
steps.expect: The Admin settings container renders with grouped sections.

steps.action: Read the admin section groups in order.
steps.expect: Workspace, People, and Work section groups are present with their section buttons.

steps.action: Click the Users & Access section button.
steps.expect: The Users & Access subview activates and renders the users/roles/grants surface instead of leaving the previous section visible.

steps.action: Return to the Admin landing via the Admin group button.
steps.expect: The Admin settings container is reachable again.

expected.usersAccessActivation: Users & Access subview activates on click

cleanup: No mutations performed; nothing to restore.
forbidden: Entering credentials or approving permission prompts.
